02 / HOW I WORK

From a conversation
to a result.

I use modern AI tools. Decisions, verification and refinement remain part of my work.

01

Understand the task.

We discuss the outcome, materials, constraints and scope, and agree on what needs to be delivered.

02

Show the direction.

03

Test and refine.

I check responsive layouts and core flows, make the agreed revisions and prepare the work for handoff.
